title: Design system: a Refero-only library with featured systems first, a pick at Add site that travels with the create request and is applied by the server once the site is up, signed-in and rate-limited preview doors that fail closed, apply and undo on a running site, and one shared history job for Site changes
steps: S1 library: GET /api/design-system/library (design-system-library-door.test.mjs) lists every Refero system the quality gate passes and nothing else (no OpenDesign), featured ids first in their given order, the rest A to Z; a featured id the gate refuses is never offered; signed out, or a mount without the sign-in check, reads 401; the shipped thumbnails are exactly the offered systems.

S2 pick at create: the Add site client puts the picked id on the create request and never writes it itself (design-system-pick.test.mjs, e2e/design-system-card.test.mjs, headless Chromium from apps/tracy-host's Playwright); tracy-web accepts only an offered Refero id (checkSystem, site-creation.test.mjs: other ids 400 before anything is created), keeps it on a site_create_design_system row, and design-system-at-create.test.mjs applies it once the site is up, as the creator, exactly once across replicas and after a crash (sweep); a site that never comes up or a failed write is said on the row and never retried; a template that cannot wear it leaves the site done with the reason.

S3 preview: the template-demo preview door and the site preview door (design-system-preview-door / design-system-site-preview-door tests) answer signed-in seats only, 401 when signed out or mounted without the sign-in check (also a small 401 page inside the frame), refuse unknown/OpenDesign/gate-refused ids before reading anything, read only the demo the server resolved; design-system-preview-rate.test.mjs: one per-account budget across both doors, the next ask 429 RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After, refused before any work, closed when the rate bucket cannot be read.

S4 apply/undo: design-system-door.test.mjs per CMS: apply records the system, undo puts back exactly what the site wore; undo of a second apply returns the first; a site changed since is not overwritten; a viewer cannot apply/undo; site preview cache forgotten on apply/undo.
S5 Site changes: history-share.test.mjs: two history reads of one site share one running job, a finished or failed answer is never reused, another site's or another kind of job is never joined.

All of it: TEST_DATABASE_URL=<a PostgreSQL the role can CREATE SCHEMA/DATABASE on> node --test --test-reporter=tap <the ten files in run.cmd> (each pg-gated file works in its own scratch schema/database via apps/tracy-web/test/_db.mjs and drops it). Locally: the stand's Postgres forwarded to 127.0.0.1:51730 (postgres://tracy:tracy@127.0.0.1:51730/tracy). Nightly: tests/regression/nightly.sh starts a throwaway postgres:16-alpine and exports TEST_DATABASE_URL. Without it the case is BLOCKED (run.needs postgres), never green on skipped tests.
expect: 0 failures, 0 skipped across the ten files; every test named in run.tests reports ok.
S1: the library is Refero-only, featured first in order, gate-refused featured never offered, 401 signed out and fail-closed without the sign-in check.
S2: the pick is sent with Create site and applied server-side once, as the creator; a non-offered id is refused 400 before anything is created; no row without a pick.
S3: preview doors 401 signed out / fail closed; over the per-account budget 429 RATE_LIMITED before any read; unknown and OpenDesign ids refused before any read.
S4: apply then undo restores the template's own look on emdash, wordpress and joomla; a viewer is refused with nothing reaching the host.
S5: concurrent history reads of one site share one job; finished/failed answers are not reused.

selectors.library: GET /api/design-system/library (apps/tracy-web/src design-system library door; featured order)
selectors.create: POST create site with a design system id -> site_create_design_system row; apps/tracy-web/src/sites/design-system-at-create.js
selectors.preview: design-system preview doors (template demo, site) with per-account rate_bucket; 401 fail closed
selectors.client: packages/site/tracy-add-site/src/client/design-system-pick.mjs; Design system card and sheet in the Add site form
selectors.history: Site changes history job shared per site (history-share)

fence: Doors and the create pipeline on fake hosts with a real PostgreSQL; the Add site card in headless Chromium with only window.fetch mocked. Not exercised: a real dsh page, a real site container, Refero's live service.
